elementary_lemmas.statement: The displayed seven-witness source parity block and twelve-witness nine-quadratic block have the same existential projection on the unchanged rational input b.
elementary_lemmas.proof: The source equation forces delta=1+bt^2 nonzero. Set u=U, v=2bt/delta and the displayed products. Reverse with U=t=0 if b=0, U=u and t=v/(u+b) if b is nonzero and u+b is nonzero, or U=b and t=0 if u=-b. In every case U^2=z, and the remaining source equations follow by substitution.
elementary_lemmas.conventions: All old witnesses and deleted lift targets are private. The exceptional branch may change the sign of U. The conclusion is equality of existential projections, not inverse bijections of the full private witness tuples. No theorem about the arithmetic meaning of the parity predicate is used.
